entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 as well as learned A.P.P. for the State.

02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present case has been filed by the opposite party no.2/ complainant who is the wife of the petitioner under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel further submits that both the parties are ready to explore the possibility of settlement, for which they submit that the matter may be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
03. Having considered the aforesaid submission, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57346 of 2024(2) dt.11-09-2024 matter is referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

sentences.text: 04. Let the petitioner and opposite party no. 2 appear before the Mediation Centre on 26.09.2024 at 11:00 A.M. along with the copy of the order and other relevant documents.
05. It is expected that the learned Mediator will try to resolve the dispute within one month from the date of first appearance of the parties.

06. List this matter on 13.11.2024 along with the report of the learned Mediator.
07.
In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner.

(Arun Kumar Jha, J) balmukund/-
